AC amendment (gap-analysis, ac_verify_defect): the integration test MUST capture the equivalence test's exit code DIRECTLY into a variable immediately after invocation (not via a pipeline, not after intervening commands) and assert on that captured value — so it measures the INNER test's verdict, not the wrapper/helper success. Add a negative self-check (force the inner test to exit non-zero under isolation and assert this test reports failure). Also assert isolation is actually in effect (empty HOME, /dev/null git config, unset DSO_*/GIT_*) at the moment the inner test runs.
  Verify: grep -Eq 'rc=\$\?|EXIT_CODE=\$\?|status=\$\?' tests/runners/test-runner-equivalence-isolated.sh  (captures $? directly, no pipeline)
